purpose: Closest executable reading of disclosed paper equations; original private features/configuration unavailable
universe: historical S&P 500 membership on decision date
feature_definition: 66 patch-local descriptors: six statistics per raw field, all21 pair correlations, VWAP/mean-close ratio, shares/trade and dollars/trade
price_fields: conservative price-eligible TAQ OHLC; no substitution with raw_*
adjustment: nominal minute price divided by same-day CRSP dlycumfacpr
missing_features: training-only finite mean imputation and standard deviation scaling; no clipping or whole-day normalization
missing_labels: Causal last eligible price carried forward, seeded by split-adjusted decision close; final minute must be observed. Same stocks at all390 horizons.
half_days: exclude decision dates with a short input OR next-session label day
boundary_purge: label date must belong to same split as decision date; allow Aug 1 2025 only for final test labels
bilevel_update: Eqs6/10 date sums; Eq13 single differentiable SGD1e-6 with writeback; Eq14 SGD on softmax logits1e-3; entropy1e-3
optimizer_ambiguity: Prioritize explicit Eqs13/14 gradient-descent updates over general AdamW prose. Softmax-logit coordinates are the executable interpretation; authors private optimizer state unavailable.
selection: patience5 on validation loss; no epoch cap; retrain argmax from fresh same-seed initialization
primary_comparison: Five-seed standard vs retrained BLO horizon, each implemented backbone; no test-based hyperparameter tuning
statistics: daily Pearson IC, Spearman RankIC, nonannualized ICIR, top-decile gross price return, annualized gross Sharpe; paired date-block bootstrap of IC difference
test_policy: do not evaluate financial test metrics until all required training/validation data and five-seed fits are complete
unspecified_choices: initial AdamW learning rate and weight decay
validation_policy: Supervised fits validate on their designated training horizon; BLO validates on final horizon390
